scope: Thirteen acquired Final Frontier reference minions with actual native keywords, prices, deaths, Choose One and physical zone operations.

face.name: 活化纪念碑
face.text: 嘲讽
face.flavorText: 它有狗头，所以是友军。

face.name: Living Monument
face.text: Taunt
face.flavorText: This is not the greatest card in the world. This is just a monument.

face.name: 月亮巨人守护者
face.text: 圣盾，复生
face.flavorText: 干掉他，然后你就会迎战新月巨人守护者。

face.name: Colossus of the Moon
face.text: Divine Shield Reborn
face.flavorText: Strike him down, and you'll face the Colossus of the New Moon.

face.name: 摩天龙
face.flavorText: 听说顺着他的脖子往上爬，会找到下金蛋的鹅。

face.name: Ultrasaur
face.flavorText: Evolved the really long neck to spy on its neighbors.

face.name: 泰拉图斯
face.text: 嘲讽。扰魔
face.flavorText: 历经数千年的演变后，它变成了我们现在所熟知的精灵龙。

face.name: Tyrantus
face.text: Taunt Elusive
face.flavorText: Millennia of evolutionary pressures turned his species into the Faerie Dragons we know today.

face.name: 冰霜巨人
face.text: 在本局对战中，你每使用一次英雄技能，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 别问他胡须是怎么来的，不然有你好受的。

face.name: Frost Giant
face.text: Costs (1) less for each time you used your Hero Power this game.
face.flavorText: Don't ask him about the beard. JUST DON'T.

face.name: 闪金镇豺狼人
face.text: 突袭 你每有一张其他手牌，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 他们在寻找一枚金戒指。据可靠消息，就在闪金镇。

face.name: Goldshire Gnoll
face.text: Rush Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
face.flavorText: They're searching for one ring. They're pretty sure someone said Goldshire.

face.name: 废料场巨像
face.text: 嘲讽，亡语：召唤一个7/7并具有嘲讽的邪爆巨像。
face.flavorText: 不积废料，无以成邪爆。

face.name: Scrapyard Colossus
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 7/7 Felcracked Colossus with Taunt.
face.flavorText: Heap on heapin' on.

face.name: 强音雷象
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：对所有敌方随从造成3点 伤害。
face.flavorText: 在演出继续之前，我们必须先处理房间里的大象。

face.name: Amplified Elekk
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: Before this show can continue, we have to bass-boost the elephant in the room.

face.name: 遗忘之王库恩
face.text: 抉择：获得10点护甲值；或者复原你的法力水晶。
face.flavorText: 艾雅抽取了库恩的些许灵魂，用以激活她的青玉大军。这可不是抽点血那么简单，遗忘之王得休息好一阵子了。

face.name: Kun the Forgotten King
face.text: Choose One - Gain 10 Armor; or Refresh your Mana Crystals.
face.flavorText: Aya siphons a bit of Kun's soul to animate each golem in her Jade army. To his credit, he's being a great sport about it.

face.name: 黑龙领主死亡之翼
face.text: 亡语：将你手牌中所有的龙牌置入战场。
face.flavorText: 这回死亡之翼听取了大家的意见，他不再单打独斗，而是以团队合作的方式重新出现在战场上。

face.name: Deathwing, Dragonlord
face.text: Deathrattle: Put all Dragons from your hand into the battlefield.
face.flavorText: To his credit, Deathwing really took to heart the feedback he was receiving that he needed to be "more of a team player".

face.flavorText: See? Giant.

face.name: 石裔干将
face.text: 突袭，亡语：召唤一只8/8并具有突袭的墓翼蝠。
face.flavorText: 铁腕治军，铁石心肠。

face.name: Stoneborn General
face.text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon an 8/8 Gravewing with Rush.
face.flavorText: Leads with an iron fist and a stony demeanor.

face.name: 典狱长
face.text: 战吼：摧毁你的牌库。本随从获得免疫。
face.flavorText: 典狱长曾是暗影界所有灵魂的仲裁官，是不偏不倚的正义典范。但那都只是曾经。

face.name: The Jailer
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy your deck. This minion gains Immune.
face.flavorText: At one point, The Jailer served as Arbiter over the souls of the Shadowlands. He was the epitome of an unbiased, righteous judge of character. WAS.

local_rules.jailer_deck_visibility: Original deck destruction uses hidden identities; exact CN reveal animation/window not calibrated.
local_rules.dragonlord_group: Capture all original own-hand current Dragon entity references at the Deathrattle body window, then delegate ordered physical recruit requests; newly gained Dragons do not join the group.
local_rules.reference_membership: Retain all 34 original reference IDs and the prior source mode/version conflict; this batch does not install a production past pool.
